title: Bad security mobile app and you could lose your life savings
body: I have used it from the time I reached UAE. In my opinion, it is an app with serious security flaws. The code of the app is done by a lazy team which does not include customer security as the first priority. For example, the text message you receive when you first register a device, when the mobile app gets updated, and when more devices get connected. I received such a message one evening since I received a similar message I did not suspect anything. It was a hacker adding his device on my device. I did not suspect anything and went to sleep. I woke up next day to know that my life time savings are gone. After complaining with FAB bank, they gladly discarded my complaint saying that it was done by you. So, please be aware of such security lapses. The small things such as a clear message about what is happening with your account is what safe guards us from fraudulent activities. But Fab is not doing everything possible from their side to help us. It is just lazy not bothered approach which made me to go away from this bank.
